title: Integrated network pharmacology and experimental validation to elucidate the mechanism of celastrol in mitigating sepsis-induced acute lung injury in mice.
authors: Zhu, Danli; Zhang, Jinghan; Huang, Xiaochun; Wei, Na; Jiang, Jinxiu; Li, Jiayao; Liu, Li; Liu, Yulin; Zhou, Jun; Jia, Jing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和湿实验研究雷公藤红素缓解脓毒症急性肺损伤的炎症机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis is an acute, life-threatening condition that precipitates multiple organ failure, including acute lung injury (ALI), characterized by a complex pathophysiological process and elevated mortality rates. Celastrol, a pentacyclic triterpenoid quinone derived from traditional Chinese medicine, exhibits diverse pharmacological properties, including immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, anticancer, and antifibrotic effects, and has demonstrated favorable safety profiles in vivo. However, the precise mechanism by which CSL contributes to sepsis-induced ALI remains to be elucidated. PURPOSE: The study aimed to explore the mechanisms by which celastrol mitigates sepsis-induced ALI using network pharmacology, followed by experimental validation of its regulatory effects on sepsis-induced ALI. METHODS: Utilizing a network pharmacology analysis, the potential targets and pathways of celastrol were identified. To explore celastrol's therapeutic effects on ALI, a rat model of sepsis was induced via cecal ligation and puncture, followed by assessment through hematoxylin-eosin staining, Real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), and Western blotting. Further investigation involved evaluating celastrol's influence on LPS-stimulated A549 and Raw264.7 cells, employing RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence techniques. RESULTS: Network pharmacological analysis identified 10 core targets and 31 pathways relevant to sepsis-induced ALI, with STAT3, TLR4, HIF-1alpha, and NF-kappaB1 emerging as central targets. Animal experiments demonstrated that celastrol treatment significantly reduced lung tissue inflammation, as evidenced by immunohistochemistry, Western blot, and RT-qPCR results, in comparison to the cecal ligation and puncture group. Notably, the levels of IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, HIF-1alpha, STAT3, and NF-kappaB1 proteins and mRNA in the celastrol treatment group were significantly reduced compared to those in the cecal ligation and puncture (CLP) group and the LPS-treated group. Additionally, Western blot and immunofluorescence analyses confirmed the activation of the NF-kappaB pathway in vitro. CONCLUSION: This study indicates that celastrol significantly suppresses the expression of inflammatory factors in sepsis-induced ALI by inhibiting the NF-kappaB/HIF-1alpha pathway in both in vivo and in vitro models, highlighting its therapeutic potential for modulating inflammation. These findings provide valuable evidence for future clinical research and drug development.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症是一种急性、危及生命的疾病，可诱发多器官衰竭，包括急性肺损伤（ALI），其特点是病理生理过程复杂且死亡率高。Celastrol（雷公藤红素）是一种源自中药的五环三萜类醌化合物，具有多种药理特性，包括免疫调节、抗炎、抗癌和抗纤维化作用，并在体内表现出良好的安全性。然而，CSL在脓毒症诱导的ALI中的确切机制仍有待阐明。目的：本研究旨在通过网络药理学探讨celastrol缓解脓毒症诱导ALI的机制，并随后通过实验验证其对脓毒症诱导ALI的调控作用。方法：利用网络药理学分析，鉴定celastrol的潜在靶点和通路。为探讨celastrol对ALI的治疗效果，通过盲肠结扎穿刺术诱导大鼠脓毒症模型，随后采用苏木精-伊红染色、实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和Western blotting进行评估。进一步研究涉及评估celastrol对LPS刺激的A549和Raw264.7细胞的影响，采用RT-qPCR、Western blotting和免疫荧光技术。结果：网络药理学分析确定了与脓毒症诱导ALI相关的10个核心靶点和31条通路，其中STAT3、TLR4、HIF-1alpha和NF-kappaB1为核心靶点。动物实验表明，与盲肠结扎穿刺组相比，celastrol治疗显著减少了肺组织炎症，这通过免疫组织化学、Western blot和RT-qPCR结果得以证实。值得注意的是，与盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）组和LPS处理组相比，celastrol治疗组中IL-1beta、TNF-alpha、HIF-1alpha、STAT3和NF-kappaB1蛋白及mRNA水平显著降低。此外，Western blot和免疫荧光分析在体外确认了NF-kappaB通路的激活。结论：本研究指出，celastrol在体内和体外模型中通过抑制NF-kappaB/HIF-1alpha通路显著抑制脓毒症诱导ALI中炎症因子的表达，突显了其调节炎症的治疗潜力。这些发现为未来的临床研究和药物开发提供了有价值的证据。
